_meta.note: 港股高股息组合 调仓/收益 结构化数据源 — 供 lib/hd_rebalance_panel.py 渲染 Strategy Picks 高股息页(v3 当前版)的『调仓纪律 & 换仓记录』区。held/sold/new 三组由 v2/v3 picks CSV 实时求差;收益链 v1→v2→v3 分段净值由页面实时算(_chain_nav 同路径)。本文件只存: 收益链分段元信息(标签/日期/n,不含收益) + 换仓逻辑 + 精简 Rulebook(愿意分/分得出/分得久)。

rebalance.logic: v3 起建仓改为纯定性评分制(2026-07-11 修订,追溯至建仓日):100 支评分池主池/缓冲池合并、不设晋升线,按「愿意分/分得出/分得久」定性总分取前 20,评分^1.5 定权;取消利率桶 55/45 配比,桶占比自然形成(建仓时利率桶约 40%);伪高息/FCF覆盖不足/周期顶等风险标注保留展示、不作一票否决。换手 80%(16/20)主因规则切换,非个股观点逐一变化。Wind 单源、派息/ROAE 口径统一沿用。
rebalance.logic_en: From v3 the build is a pure qualitative-score scheme (revised 2026-07-11, restated to inception): the 100-name scored pool is merged (core + buffer, no promotion line), top 20 by the willing/able/durable total score, weights ∝ score^1.5; the 55/45 rate-bucket anchor is retired (rate share forms naturally, ~40% at build); risk flags (pseudo-high-yield / FCF shortfall / cycle-peak) are displayed but no longer veto. The 80% turnover (16/20) is driven by the rule switch, not name-by-name view changes. Wind single-source and unified payout/ROAE definitions carry over.

rate.label: 利率溢价桶
rate.note: 利率下行重估的高股息(银行 / 公用 / 高速)
rate.note_en: high-div names that re-rate as rates fall (banks / utilities / toll roads)

nonrate.label: 非利率桶
nonrate.note: 盈利与治理驱动的高股息(消费 / 制造 / 能源)

rebalance.risk: 高股息非无风险:利率溢价桶对久期敏感(利率反弹回撤),非利率桶依赖盈利兑现;payout 卡 band 边界票须 HKEXnews 逐笔重算终核。
rebalance.risk_en: High-div isn't riskless: the rate bucket is duration-sensitive (drawdown if rates back up), the non-rate bucket depends on earnings delivery; payout-band edge cases need a HKEXnews line-by-line recompute.

rulebook.positioning: 设计起点:三维框架 + 55/25/20 权重为『先验合理值』,须走前瞻账本 vs 死等权影子对照验证后才升级『已验证』。
rulebook.positioning_en: Design baseline: the 3-dim framework + 55/25/20 weights are prior-reasonable, promoted to 'validated' only after a forward ledger vs dead-equal-weight shadow control.
rulebook.core: 高股息超额 = 股息复利 + 估值修复(利率下行时利率溢价桶重估)。唯一确定有 edge 的动作 = 选『愿意分(治理)× 分得出(现金流)× 分得久(护城河)』三重达标、payout 可持续的公司,按综合分定权、按漂移再平衡;唯一确定该禁的 = 追高息陷阱(高 yield 往往是股价跌出来的)+ 忽视 payout 可持续性。
rulebook.core_en: High-div excess return = dividend compounding + valuation repair (the rate bucket re-rates as rates fall). The only sure edge = pick names that clear all three of willing-to-pay (governance) × able-to-pay (cash flow) × able-to-keep-paying (moat) with a sustainable payout, set weights by the composite score, rebalance on drift. The only sure prohibition = the high-yield trap (a high yield is usually a fallen price) + ignoring payout sustainability.

rules.title: 三维达标线(愿意分 × 分得出 × 分得久)
rules.desc: 公司治理 55% · 财务质量/现金流 25% · 行业护城河 20%,三重达标才入池
rules.desc_en: Governance 55% · cash-flow quality 25% · moat 20% — must clear all three

rules.title: payout 卡 band + 银行用加权 ROAE
rules.desc: payout 30/70/100% band,>100% 或举债分红=红旗;银行必用加权 ROAE(公布值)非摊薄
rules.desc_en: payout 30/70/100% band; >100% or debt-funded = red flag; banks use weighted ROAE, not diluted

rules.title: 评分定权,非等权
rules.desc: 综合分^1.5 定权(v1 等权 → v2/v3 定权),单票硬上限 10%(v3 建仓实际 4.2-4.7%)
rules.desc_en: weights ∝ composite score^1.5 (v1 EW → v2/v3 weighted); 10% hard single-name cap (4.2-4.7% at v3 build)

rules.title: 现金缓冲 ~12%
rules.desc: 常态留 ~12% 现金(策略设计非误差),留再平衡与错杀弹药
rules.desc_en: hold ~12% cash by design (not an error) — dry powder for rebalancing / mispricings

rules.title: 权重漂移再平衡
rules.desc: 权重漂移超目标带触发 trim/add 回锚,不追涨杀跌
rules.desc_en: trim/add back to target when weight drifts past the band; no chase

rules.title: 评分掉档 → 人工 review
rules.desc: 治理 / payout / 护城河 恶化=真信号该动;价格波动=噪音不机械砍
rules.desc_en: governance/payout/moat deterioration is a real signal; price noise isn't — don't auto-cut

avoid.why: 高 dividend yield 常是股价跌出来的(分母塌),先看 payout 可持续再看 yield
avoid.why_en: a high yield is often a fallen price (collapsed denominator); check payout sustainability before yield

avoid.t: 用摊薄 ROE 评银行
avoid.why: 银行优秀线按加权 ROAE 校准,摊薄会系统性少给分
avoid.why_en: the bank quality line is calibrated on weighted ROAE; diluted systematically under-scores

avoid.t: 直引 iFind 派息字段
avoid.why: 港股派息聚合字段跨中期+末期口径混乱,卡 band 时必用 HKEXnews 逐笔重算
avoid.why_en: HK payout aggregate fields blur interim+final; at a band edge, recompute line-by-line from HKEXnews

rulebook.phase_note: v1 等权(34→Top20,2026-03)起步 → v2 评分定权 + 12% 现金(2026-06)→ v3 Wind 单源重算、派息/ROAE 口径统一(2026-07)。攒够前瞻样本后再谈桶内分层 / 动态权重。
rulebook.phase_note_en: v1 equal-weight (34→top20, Mar-2026) → v2 score-weighted + 12% cash (Jun-2026) → v3 Wind single-source rebuild with unified payout/ROAE (Jul-2026). Intra-bucket tiering / dynamic weights only after enough forward samples.
